posts.summary_en: Official notes for the 8/13 update: the Crumble Dungeon daily ranking ('오늘의 랭킹') settlement moves from 00:00-01:00 to 12:00-13:00 KST to match maintenance, and the score-mission thresholds are lowered.

quotes.kr: 크럼블 던전 점수 달성 미션 요구 점수 완화

posts.summary_en: Official notes for the 9/10 update: when buffs of the same kind overlap, the one with the higher final (stacked) value now applies; manual control of cookies in Guild Conquest and Crumble Dungeon is removed. A comment complains that records need levelling and resetting 40 cookies.
mechanics: Same-type buffs: the stronger stacked value wins (9/10).

quotes.kr: 길드 토벌전 및 크럼블 던전 진행 중 쿠키의 수동 조작이 가능하던 현상이 수정됩니다.
quotes.en: Manual control of cookies in Guild Conquest and Crumble Dungeon is fixed.

posts.summary_en: Official notes for the 9/23 update (Princess Bari, Rumble Arena, the Dimensional Rift): long-pressing the level-up button now opens a fine level control, and gear presets can change while oven gear is out. No Crumble Dungeon rule change is listed.
mechanics: Level fine-control added 9/23, which is how players set dungeon levels.

posts.title_kr: 크럼블 던전 일일 보상 왜 다르게 들어오는지 알아냄
posts.summary_en: The visible board is the weekly best; the daily ranking resets each day and ranks that day's best run, so a score must be set every day.
mechanics: Two boards: weekly (best of the week, shown) and daily (best of the day, hidden).

posts.summary_en: Beginner guide by 쿠키런 연두 (dungeon section added 9/17, Lv.1 list 9/21, ranking rules 9/22). Named portraits of the dungeon lineup (image 13) and a screen of the cookies set to Lv.1 (image 14). Levels: charge and ranged Lv.90-95, support Lv.60-80, everything else Lv.1. Weekly reward pays the week's best; daily reward pays the day's score.
mechanics: Weekly board pays the best record of the week; daily board pays that day's score.

posts.summary_en: Section 4.4 (updated 9/22): run once a day for the participation reward; ranking closes at midnight, rewards the next day at noon; weekly top 100 earns the 황금빛 광채 title. Its tips repeat dc:62042: the top 40 by power deploy first and earn most of the score, arena gear built on Skill Haste, crit damage, crit rate and Skill AMP, Milk as captain with the top ATK, ATK order Milk > Scorpion > Figure > other dealers, Milk and Figure in the top three. The deck images are dc:72051's roster. Also: Crumble Dungeon, Arena and Implant Tower rank per server, not across servers.

quotes.kr: 크럼블 던전, 아레나, 임플란트 타워 랭킹은 전 서버 통합이 아닌 서버별로 집계됩니다.
quotes.en: Crumble Dungeon, Arena and Implant Tower rankings are per server, not merged.

posts.summary_en: By 뱅국: every cookie enters, but only 40 deploy first, so adjust levels; gear toward higher power; Milk and Figure as ATK #1 and #2 by lowering dealers; perks Passion Pay, Rapid Promotion, Crunch Mode and Like A Family. Lineup by rarity (TSSR, SSR, SR, R, U) in the post, with two roster screenshots.

By 서신우, linking his video (yt F9BzQ4DAbWg): in-fight screen at 2.000 s left reading 127,087,255,085 at 10G 150M, 0 cookies left. A commenter suggests Passion Pay with '5사격' and a 6 Skill Haste / 6 Skill AMP arena setting, which gave his own best. The first image is empty (0 bytes) in the capture.
Launch-week question: higher power but lower damage than others; replies blame synergy uptime and crit rate varying per run.
